notes: Draft configuration: The independently mapped 2020 main paved oval retains both rounded ends and excludes nearby recreation and motocross courses. Its 531.0 m source centerline matches the catalogue oval identity and remains unscaled against the 538 m timing scalar. The racing team identifies the former Western Speedway venue and its final 2022 event; its advertised 4/10-mile distance differs from this mapped centerline. Historical pavement alignment remains draft. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 531.0 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

Estimated constant-width corridor: width is stored in track.json; inner, outer and ideal lines are calculated in the browser from the mapped trace. Local widening and earlier boundary corrections are not retained by this approximation.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 16 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
